mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_query_log where status = #{status}
select coalesce(sum(fee), 0) from biz_query_log where status = '0'
select count(1) from biz_insurance_company where status = #{status}
select count(1) from biz_query_log where request_time >= curdate() and request_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)

select date_format(request_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value, coalesce(sum(case when status = '0' then fee else 0 end), 0) as amount from biz_query_log where request_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(request_time, '%Y-%m') order by name
select query_type as name, count(1) as value, coalesce(sum(case when status = '0' then fee else 0 end), 0) as amount from biz_query_log group by query_type order by value desc

select c.company_name as name, count(l.id) as value, coalesce(sum(case when l.status = '0' then l.fee else 0 end), 0) as amount from biz_query_log l left join biz_insurance_company c on l.company_id = c.id group by c.company_name order by value desc limit 10
